title: Fronteras y territorios
goal: Read about the legal principle meant to prevent border wars by freezing old colonial lines, and why it mostly failed since much of the interior had never been surveyed.

items: Explain what kind of borders the new countries actually inherited.
Explain what uti possidetis juris was and why it was hard to apply.
State whether 19th-century territorial disputes were resolved quickly.
Explain why internal territorial organization kept changing.
Use passive voice to trace what happened to borders and legal principles over time.
